---
title: "About"
---

I'm Meghanadh Pulivarthi. I work on machine learning — inference pipelines, agentic
systems, and empirical experiments.

This site collects what I learn as I work through [CS336](https://stanford-cs336.github.io/),
Stanford's *Language Modeling from Scratch*. The course is deliberately
implementation-heavy: you build the tokenizer, the attention, the optimizer, and the
training loop yourself, with very little scaffolding. Writing the explanations down is
how I check my own understanding.

Posts here explain concepts. They are not assignment solutions.
